description: Curated workflow families. Conceptual states are not new wire enums; source-index.json provides broader candidate evidence.

workflows.transitions: hydrating → first-run / complete → journal / login
workflows.decision: Onboarding completion is persisted; cloud absence must preserve offline journal mode. Keep.

workflows.transitions: restoring → signed-out / guest / signed-in / offline-only; signup → confirmation-needed / session
workflows.decision: Keep Supabase authority. Follow-up: hydration errors, reset recovery deep link, stale account profile responses.

workflows.transitions: unowned → adopted; owned-by-self → allowed; owned-by-other → conflict → explicit wipe/signout
workflows.decision: Never silently adopt another user's journal. Sync run has its own owner/session check. Follow-up: coordinate ownership resolution, wipe and all in-flight writes across account changes.

workflows.transitions: unknown → fetched / offline-cached; guidelines missing → accepted
workflows.decision: RLS/RPC remains authoritative. Follow-up: explicitly represent profile loading before showing community forms.

workflows.transitions: checking → disabled / locked → authenticating → unlocked / cancelled; background → locked
workflows.decision: Hardware/enrolment/prompt are asynchronous. Follow-up: fail-closed policy for unavailable hardware and overlapping prompts requires device tests.

workflows.transitions: paused / idle → syncing → success / partial / error → retry
workflows.decision: **Changed:** one explicit status model; same-account callers share work, other-account callers do not receive its result, stale account/attempt completions ignored, partial errors do not update successful-backup time. Existing context booleans retained as projections.

workflows.transitions: pending → pushed → synced; remote newer → merged; pending local edit → protected
workflows.decision: Preserve updated_at guarded acknowledgement and pending-edit precedence. No DB schema/merge semantics changed.

workflows.transitions: local delete → tombstone pending → remote delete → tombstone cleared
workflows.decision: Deletes precede pushes; failed deletion remains retryable. Keep.

workflows.transitions: starting cursor → page fetched → locally inserted → cursor advanced → next page / complete
workflows.decision: Cursor uses created_at + id; preserve owner reset and page boundaries. Keep.

workflows.transitions: local file → upload → storage path → metadata write → synced; failure → retry path
workflows.decision: Uploaded bytes and metadata commit are separate states. Keep existing metadata retry; follow-up: coordinate concurrent local edits and cleanup.

workflows.transitions: draft → valid/invalid → saving → saved / error
workflows.decision: Destination-derived defaults must not overwrite explicit edits. Keep.

workflows.transitions: active ↔ completed; date-derived upcoming/current/past; cancelled excluded from matching
workflows.decision: Stored status and calendar phase are separate dimensions; preserve both.

workflows.transitions: private ↔ link/public; link created → shared → disabled/unavailable
workflows.decision: Keep private default and server link authorization. No publication is implied by exporting a file.

workflows.transitions: new/edit → saving → saved/error; delete → pending tombstone
workflows.decision: Preserve offline saves. Attachments and entry save are separate effects requiring recovery on partial failure. Keep.

workflows.transitions: permission → pick/cancel → persist → attach; viewer closed/open; remove → pending sync
workflows.decision: Keep local durable file before metadata. Device/storage failure tests remain required.

workflows.transitions: idle → requesting permission → preparing → recording → stopping → saved / error / cancelled; playback paused/playing/ended
workflows.decision: Audio recorder lifecycle is native; leave APIs unchanged. Follow-up: cancellation/audio-mode cleanup and single recorder ownership.

workflows.transitions: stopped → permission → starting → recording → stopping; battery ↔ precise; OS-stopped → stale marker cleared
workflows.decision: Persisted intent and actual OS task state differ. Follow-up: serialized start/stop/mode changes, start failure rollback and reboot/device tests.

workflows.transitions: off / trip-only / live-only / trip-and-live
workflows.decision: One OS service serves two purposes; stopping one must preserve the other. Keep current APIs; device-test transitions before refactor.

workflows.transitions: creating → active → expired/ended; location → throttled push → updated / retry
workflows.decision: Follow-up: revoke acknowledgement and account binding; local clearing must not imply remote revocation succeeded. Keep expiration safeguards.

workflows.transitions: building → file written → native share / fallback → complete/cancel/error
workflows.decision: Export is not automatic publishing. Keep.

workflows.transitions: editing → local saved; rates cached → fetching → fresh / stale/error; debt derived → settlement suggestion
workflows.decision: Keep deterministic money arithmetic and explicit missing rates. Independent inputs do not need machines.

workflows.transitions: unchecked ↔ packed; draft → saved/reordered/deleted → pending sync
workflows.decision: Preserve item IDs and offline mutation behavior. Keep.

workflows.transitions: invite unknown → validated → joined / rejected; member → left/removed
workflows.decision: Server capacity, roles and membership checks remain authoritative. Keep.

workflows.transitions: initial → refreshing → ready/empty/error → loading-more → exhausted; definition change → reset
workflows.decision: Follow-up: generation guard must cover errors/finally and disabled feeds, not just success. Keep optimistic edits and pagination behavior pending focused tests.

workflows.transitions: composing → uploading → publishing → visible/error; liked ↔ unliked; comment draft → posted/deleted
workflows.decision: Server counters/authorization canonical; posting visibility explicit. Keep.

workflows.transitions: not-following ↔ following; unblocked ↔ blocked
workflows.decision: Optimistic UI must rollback failures; profile discoverability and message permission are separate rules. Keep.

workflows.transitions: disconnected → subscribed/poll-refresh → snapshot; unread → read; conversation active/inactive
workflows.decision: Follow-up: account-generation protection and reactive active-conversation state for badge counts. Keep native badge behavior.

workflows.transitions: absent → joined → member/admin/owner → left/removed; muted ↔ unmuted
workflows.decision: RLS/RPC controls read/write/role transitions; never infer membership from navigation. Keep.

workflows.transitions: opening → ready/error; live subscribed/reconnecting; older-page loading → merged/exhausted
workflows.decision: Preserve history order and message IDs. Follow-up: route/account scoped async effects and paging races.

workflows.transitions: draft → optimistic pending → acknowledged / failed → manual retry
workflows.decision: pending/failed flags should eventually become a delivery union. Backend idempotency needed before automatic retry; preserve existing manual recovery.

workflows.transitions: draft → open → full / closed
workflows.decision: Server acceptance updates capacity transactionally; keep.

workflows.transitions: absent → pending → accepted / declined; pending → cancelled
workflows.decision: Preserve RPC actor, capacity and terminal-request guards; accepted request may create/join conversation. Keep.

workflows.transitions: invisible → permission granted → visible-until-expiry → hidden/expired
workflows.decision: Opt-in, coarsening and expiry stay server enforced. Keep; exact location never substitutes for coarse presence.

workflows.transitions: trip selected → pushed → querying → matches/empty/error → contact
workflows.decision: Preserve local trip sync before RPC and discoverability/date/status guards. Keep.

workflows.transitions: query → suggestions/results; tip draft → posted; voted ↔ unvoted
workflows.decision: Latest query owns displayed data; server owns eligibility/counters. Keep; audit stale query handling.

workflows.transitions: contacts edited → saved; location acquired → SMS composer → sent/cancelled/unknown
workflows.decision: Composer launch is not proof SOS was sent; no background automatic messaging. Keep.

workflows.transitions: off → reminders scheduled → due → overdue → checked-in/cancelled
workflows.decision: This is a local reminder, not an emergency monitoring service. Follow-up: handle partial scheduling failures.

workflows.transitions: unset → granted/denied → enabled/disabled; registered token → forgotten
workflows.decision: Native permission, preference and server token are distinct states. Keep; device/account-switch testing remains.

workflows.transitions: confirm → deleting cloud → wiping device → signed-out; any failure → partial recovery
workflows.decision: Never represent partial deletion as complete; follow-up: coordinate running sync/recording and all cleanup effects.

workflows.sources: `src/context/ThemeContext.tsx`, `src/context/ToastContext.tsx`, app and ui components in source index
workflows.transitions: system/light/dark; notice visible → timer dismissed; modal open/closed; selected tab
workflows.decision: Keep independent simple state; no reducer/framework needed.

workflows.transitions: loading → local/server-derived stats; traveller → hardcore → legendary; badge earned/unearned
workflows.decision: Server-verified distance/altitude remains distinct from client estimates. Keep.

workflows.transitions: idle → loading/refreshing → data/empty/error; poll → stale/current/expired
workflows.decision: One request lifecycle per resource, scoped to account and resource. Keep; explicit state only when coupling requires it.

workflows.transitions: source checks → bundles → signed builds → device acceptance → release
workflows.decision: Preserve build/store gates. No migration/deployment/publication performed.

workflows.transitions: absent → creating (single flight, journal lock) → ready; duplicates after sync → lowest id kept, entries moved; today unwritten → written; memories none → shown
workflows.decision: Stored as a private trip (`trip_type = 'everyday'`) so sync, media and backup are reused; excluded from journey lists, matching, safety trip lookup, travel trip counts and server `trips_count`. Device test of two-phone duplicate merge remains.

workflows.transitions: loading → cached user / signed-out; signin/signup → persisted → routed; signout → cleared
workflows.decision: Follow-up: one atomic session record, malformed-cache recovery and generation-scoped restoration. Cached identity is not server authentication.

workflows.transitions: editing → submitting → success/error
workflows.decision: Keep existing payload/role options; duplicate submit guards and partial persistence recovery remain follow-ups.

workflows.transitions: storage absent/present → route denied/allowed; form idle/submitting/success/error
workflows.decision: Guard checks local storage, server JWT is authoritative. Web reset API lifecycle is incomplete; do not claim it works from the form alone.

workflows.transitions: editing → hashtag suggestions → selected tags → submitting → session/error
workflows.decision: Preserve question and selected tags on failure. Follow-up: same-tick submit lock and stale tag queries.

workflows.transitions: question accepted → scored candidates → solver selected → session created → initial message created
workflows.decision: Creation and first message are separate writes; follow-up atomic transaction. Current fallback can select seeker as solver; introduce unavailable/waiting policy only as an explicit product change.

workflows.transitions: seeker ↔ solver; loading → sessions/empty/error; selectedSession 0 → selected ID
workflows.decision: Keep role mode separate from auth; follow-up per-account/mode request scope and visible list retry.

workflows.transitions: active true/false in schema
workflows.decision: There is no complete close/reopen lifecycle or active-write gate in current API. Inventory the latent machine; do not invent closure behavior without endpoint/product design.

workflows.transitions: loading → ready/error → retry; socket disconnected → connected/reconnected → history reconciliation
workflows.decision: **Changed:** typed reducer, request IDs, per-account/session keyed screen, merge by server ID, retain live arrivals when history finishes, reconnect rejoin/reload, visible loading/error/retry.

workflows.transitions: draft → sending → acknowledgement/error
workflows.decision: **Changed:** synchronous operation lock, visible error, draft retained on failure, text typed during a send survives acknowledgement, HTTP/socket deduplication. Backend idempotency remains needed for ambiguous network failure/manual retry.

workflows.transitions: idle → permission → picking → cancel/uploading → acknowledged/error
workflows.decision: **Changed:** one operation state for text/photo, lock released after cancellation/failure, permission feedback and visible errors. Native picker/API format preserved. Follow-up server authorization before file commitment, file limits, safe types and orphan cleanup.

workflows.transitions: selected → initial fetch → 5s polling; draft/file → sending/uploading → reload/error; deselect/destroy → timer stopped
workflows.decision: Follow-up unsubscribe/scope pending HTTP responses, preserve drafts on failed send and add retry/loading feedback. Leave web transport behavior unchanged in this patch.

workflows.transitions: socket connected → join requested → room joined → message broadcast → disconnect
workflows.decision: **High priority unresolved:** socket join currently accepts arbitrary session IDs without authenticating membership. HTTP guards do not secure the socket. Add token handshake + membership check with server/client integration tests before production. Reconnect improvements do not fix this.

workflows.transitions: loaded → editing → saving → saved/error; password old → verified → changed
workflows.decision: Keep actor identity from JWT. Follow-up verify UI/API password contract and token invalidation; do not assume a password form guarantees complete lifecycle support.

workflows.transitions: editing → submitting → subscribed/duplicate/error
workflows.decision: Keep database email uniqueness and show an actionable duplicate/error outcome in a later focused patch.

workflows.transitions: modal closed/open → publish notice; seeded posts published/unpublished
workflows.decision: This is placeholder UI/in-memory sample data, not persisted publication. Do not turn private chat into a public post implicitly. Follow-up explicit consent, preview, persist, moderation and revocation workflow.

workflows.sources: Login, profile, search/notification components and all candidates in `source-index.json`
workflows.transitions: form validity; query/selection; dialog open/closed; loading/data/empty/error
workflows.decision: Keep simple fields local. Represent request lifecycle explicitly when several flags must agree; scope effects and stale callbacks to current account/resource.

workflows.transitions: configured → checks → bundle → signed build → staging → release
workflows.decision: No backend migration, deployment or store submission. SDK upgrades and signing remain separate from this state refactor.

workflows.transitions: query empty → saved list; query ≥ 2 → searching → results / nothing found / error; message unsaved → saving → saved / reverted on failure; saved → removing → unsaved / reverted
workflows.decision: Private to each member and limited to their own conversations; blocked peers are hidden as in the chat list; another member's message reads as missing. Saved set is scoped to the signed-in account, the newest request wins, and a synchronous per-message pending set (module state, not React state) blocks double taps. Saves go with the conversation or the account.
